"""Plant one change in a copy of the tree: python3 -I plant.py <copy> <plant>."""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root, plant = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
src = root / "template" / ".rulesync" / "hooks.jsonc"
lines = src.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(keepends=True)
# lines are 1-indexed in the file: 17 is "      }," after the guard entry, 18..23 the context watch entry
assert "posttooluse.py" in lines[14] and "context_watch.py" in lines[20], (lines[14][:80], lines[20][:80])

if plant == "a_no_watch":
    # drop the context watch entry (lines 18..23) and the comma after the guard entry
    lines[16] = lines[16].replace("},", "}")
    del lines[17:23]
elif plant == "b_extra_entry":
    # a third postToolUse entry running another kernel program (precompact.py), not exempt
    extra = lines[17:23]
    extra = [l.replace("context_watch.py", "precompact.py") for l in extra]
    lines[22] = lines[22].replace("}", "},")
    lines[23:23] = extra
elif plant == "c_watch_matcher":
    assert '"matcher": "Bash"' in lines[19]
    lines[19] = lines[19].replace('"Bash"', '"Bash|Edit"')
elif plant == "d_whole_event":
    # mutant of portability: the old whole-event lift (every entry of a lifted event left out)
    p = root / "src" / "gov" / "adapters" / "portability.py"
    t = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    old = "kept = [entry for entry in listed if not (event in leave_out and _runs_lifted(entry))]"
    assert old in t
    p.write_text(t.replace(old, "kept = [] if event in leave_out else list(listed)"), encoding="utf-8")
elif plant == "e_guard_limit":
    # the guard's postToolUse entry carries 30, not 60
    assert '"timeout": 60' in lines[15]
    lines[15] = lines[15].replace("60", "30")
else:
    raise SystemExit(f"unknown plant {plant}")
src.write_text("".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
print("planted", plant)
